other_conditions: The applicant must be the nominee, dependent, or legal heir of the deceased worker.
The deceased must have been a registered building or construction worker with the Telangana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
The death must have occurred on the spot or be due to injuries from an accident that happened at the workplace or elsewhere.
benefits_summary: A relief amount of ₹6,00,000 is provided to the nominee, dependents, or legal heirs of the deceased registered worker.
